posts.description: Equitybee Benchmark helps U.S. startup employees understand how their equity grants compare. Data presented as is.

posts.name: Xirp
posts.tagline: The agentic development environment built by Spotify

posts.name: Bullet
posts.tagline: 30-60% faster than Claude Code and Codex
posts.description: Bullet is a coding agent built for speed. We got tired of burning hours waiting on agent runs. The models were fine, but the loops around them were slow. Bullet auto-picks the right model/reasoning level per prompt, parallelizes searches/reads/commands, and uses targeted code search instead of embedding your whole repo. Works with your Claude Code or Codex subscription, API keys, or an on-device model. 95.8% on SWE-bench Verified (top 3), 119s/task. Built by Yale CS grads, ex-AppLovin/Citadel.

posts.name: bb
posts.tagline: The IDE that builds itself
posts.description: bb is an agentic orchestrator GUI, not unlike the Codex app, but it works with any provider: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. What makes bb different is that it can customize and extend itself. Almost anything in bb can be changed with a single prompt. Ask for a task tracker, and one appears. bb also creates a skill that teaches all of your agents how to use it. Instead of waiting for your agentic workspace to add the feature you need, you can just ask for it.

posts.name: Continuum
posts.tagline: Remember what you know about the people you manage
posts.description: Continuum is a private Mac app for managers. You write down what you believe about each person you lead, tag what you notice in your 1:1s, and let your read change on the record. No scores, no reports, nothing that leaves your Mac.

posts.name: Vizard Agent
posts.tagline: One AI agent for every kind of video
posts.description: Vizard Agent is a general AI video agent built to take on the whole video job. Start with raw footage, an existing video, a URL, a script, an image, or just an idea. Tell it what you want to make, and it figures out the work in between, from editing and generation to repurposing, localization, and revisions. Instead of managing a different tool for every step, you give one agent the outcome you want and work with it until the video is finished.

posts.name: Product Analytics for Agents and Users
posts.tagline: Optimize Agent Actions with User Behavior.
posts.description: Kubit helps product engineers optimize AI agents with user behavior. Connect agent traces directly to user activities to see exactly why users re-prompt, drop off, or convert. Then, feed those insights straight into your coding agent to build AI products that actually stick. Start instantly with seamless integrations via OTel, your CDP, or Bring Your Own Warehouse (BYOW).

posts.name: Octomind Cloud and Hub
posts.tagline: One login, zero API keys — cloud agents + 27 models
posts.description: Run AI agents in the cloud — pick a machine, tell it what to do, close your laptop. Sessions resume from any device. Per-second billing, 21 models built in, no API keys. Solved 24/25 benchmark tasks — ahead of Claude Code and Codex.

posts.name: Gitar
posts.tagline: AI code review that fixes what it finds
posts.description: Gitar reviews pull requests, diagnoses CI failures, applies fixes, and validates the changes against your pipeline. It can also retry flaky tests, automate review workflows, and act directly inside GitHub or GitLab. Now part of Sonar.

posts.name: Cerenovus
posts.tagline: Proactively find the money your company is losing
posts.description: We ingest information from around your company (documents, communications and databases), and map out your company's workflows, along with the bottlenecks and inefficiencies within those workflows. Then, we figure out how to fix the problems (and whether their worth fixing). Then, we give you cited, human-verified reports outlining concrete, actionable steps you can take to see real results.

posts.name: agent-manager
posts.tagline: The fastest workflow for developing with AI
posts.description: Run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Grok and Pi in one tmux list with live status per session. space answers a blocked agent without attaching, f forks the conversation into a named sibling, T pins a plain shell next to the agents, and ctrl+r opens whole-file diffs where line comments go back as one review prompt. Sessions can spawn into their own git worktrees. Ordinary tmux sessions survive quitting the manager. One Go binary, Apache-2.0. macOS, Linux, Windows via WSL2.

posts.name: Gotcha
posts.tagline: World's First AI Copilot for Android. You talk. It acts.
posts.description: Control your Android phone using natural language. Gotcha is a free, open-source on-device AI copilot featuring 100+ native device tools, dual safety modes, and real-time voice calls over any app, powered by Samosa AIR (LLM, STT, and TTS).

posts.name: AMP by CanyonTechs AI
posts.tagline: AI agents that act. Automation that delivers.
posts.description: AMP autonomously monitors production logs, detects incidents, and opens a reviewable PR with the fix — no prompting needed. 80%+ fix rate. Certified for Java, Python, TypeScript, Node.js & Rust. No direct prod access. Human-in-the-loop. Use code PH3MOFREE.

posts.name: Lexi
posts.tagline: The operating system for legal work

ScreenMark Pro unlocks recording, live zoom, cursor highlight and flashlight, advanced annotation, custom break-mode, custom shortcuts available in pro.

posts.name: AdmitRaven

It helps you craft authentic, compelling essays, stay on top of every deadline and requirement, and match to the right schools and scholarships. You can even read real admitted students' essays from your dream school, and ask them questions directly.

Instead, decision-makers spend hours gathering files, fixing formulas, and checking assumptions before they can act. Orion provides that missing analytical capacity. It turns spreadsheets, CRM and ERP data, dashboards, and project files into trustworthy, actionable insights, helping business owners, operators, and analysts make smarter, faster decisions.

Send a picture everyone sees as an innocent cover; your trusted contact opens it in PrivateMark to reveal the real photo, sealed with AES-256.

From instant RFP shredding and persona‑driven ghostwriting to financial margin analysis, red‑teaming in a Virtual Review Room, and one‑click pitch deck generation, RiverProposal equips teams to respond faster, smarter, and with higher win rates.

Import compatible bank-statement CSVs to spot recurring charges, set renewal reminders, explore spending, and ask Folio—an optional on-device analyst—about your ledger. Your financial records stay on your iPhone. Pro is one lifetime purchase, not another subscription.

posts.description: Listrino audits any Airbnb or Booking.com listing against four signals: Listing Reviews, Top listings in your City. Similar properties worldwide and Platform best practices. Outputs a ranked plan split into: What to Fix, What to leverage and What to Steal from competitors.

posts.tagline: Stop throwaway emails before they hit your database
posts.description: IsItDisposable detects disposable and throwaway emails at signup. Stop trial abusers cycling burner emails through your free tier, and keep throwaways from wrecking your list quality. A live dataset of 211,812 domains, MX-validated and refreshed daily, with about 320 new ones appearing every day. One API call or a drop-in script tag, and it fails open: if we are ever down, signups keep working. Relays like Apple Hide My Email are flagged, not blocked. Free plan plus a 14-day trial, no card.

posts.name: Cosminds
posts.tagline: Organize what you learn by idea, not by source

Cosminds organizes what you read and watch by idea, not by source: books, PDFs, YouTube, articles and notes become one library. It pulls out the claims, drills you until you can write them back from memory, and its AI Wiki answers only from what you put in, with citations, never from the web. Runs on Claude inside the EU. Never sold, never used to train anything. Free to start, no card.

posts.name: amphi
posts.tagline: AI Notes & Flashcards designed by students

Instead of switching between separate apps, you can study in a single place where your tools stay next to the work you are doing. Having all your work in one place gives your AI tutor the context to understand what you are working on and help you study how you learn best.

No guessing what the AI did to your product.

Your data never leaves your device. Now on iOS and Android. Built by one person, with care.

The power of an agent, in a workspace you can actually see and control.

posts.description: An interactive railway map of the world: 1,247 notable train routes across 120 countries, drawn on one map you can pan, zoom and search. Click any line for its distance, fastest scheduled journey time, the speed it actually averages end to end, top speed, operator, opening year, a photograph and the story of the line. High speed, classic, night, scenic, heritage, luxury and mountain, filterable by type and by how long you have. Free, no signup, no ads, open data.

posts.name: TribeCrafter
posts.tagline: All-in-one community platform. 0% platform fees.
posts.description: TribeCrafter gives you everything you need to build and sell a community in one place. Create courses, groups, memberships, and premium content, then bundle them into free or paid offers in 18 currencies. Feed, events, blog, messaging, and 0% platform fees are all included.

posts.name: LumisReach v2
posts.tagline: Light Up your Conversations
posts.description: LumisReach v2 helps businesses to reach, convert, and keep their ideal customers with a team of autonomous self-improving AI agents. Our suite of inbound and outbound Voice AI tools are designed to boost real business outcomes by following up with leads and customers in real time, while our high-touch customer service ensures the whole system runs exactly as intended without worrying about costly maintenance.

posts.name: HYPERSCALE
posts.tagline: HYPERSCALE - Compute Empire
posts.description: Build and scale an AI data center empire. Manage power, compute, and cooling across specialized facilities, research a deep multi-tier tech tree, automate contract fulfillment with hired staff, and unlock rare materials for late-game hardware. Prestige to go public and compound your growth. A browser-based incremental tycoon built for long-term play.

posts.name: Edith
posts.tagline: An honest whole-book editor that never rewrites you
posts.description: Edith reads your whole novel, up to 150,000 words, then gives you honest editorial notes from structure down to the line, one at a time. You keep every word: she suggests, she never rewrites. Coming soon. Join the waitlist and your first Editorial Review is free, normally $15.

posts.name: Kwilio Scheduling
posts.tagline: Build the roster once. Your team always knows.
posts.description: Kwilio replaces the group chat, the spreadsheet and the roster on the wall. Managers build the schedule on desktop; staff get an iPhone app with their shifts, clock in/out, open shifts to claim, and time off requests. Flat monthly pricing by team size.

posts.name: Centrl Studio
posts.tagline: The studio software that runs on WhatsApp
posts.description: Centrl Studio helps Indian yoga, dance, fitness, and Pilates studios manage memberships, payments, attendance, and renewals — all from a dashboard built around WhatsApp, since that's how Indian studio owners actually talk to their members. GST-ready receipts, no spreadsheets, 14-day free trial.

posts.name: FlightWifi
posts.tagline: Know your flight's Wi-Fi before you book.
posts.description: Google Flights says "Wi-Fi for a fee." It never says whether that wifi can hold a video call or barely load an email. FlightWifi adds an honest verdict to every flight on Google Flights and Skyscanner: - video calls work (Starlink-class), - email only (GEO satellite), - no wifi on this aircraft, - or not yet verified. Verdicts are per aircraft, not per airline. No permissions, no accounts, zero network requests. Free.

posts.name: OpenTeller
posts.tagline: Private budgeting for any bank, in the AI you already use
posts.description: Most budgeting apps reach your bank through an aggregator, and the free ones pay for that access by profiling what you spend. OpenTeller has no middleman. You log into your bank inside the app, train it once, then sync in one tap. Any bank, any country, credentials never leaving your device. In no account mode, your data sits encrypted in your own iCloud. Categorization runs on Apple Intelligence, on-device. You can bring your own AI. An MCP endpoint lets Claude and ChatGPT read your data

posts.name: Habit Arc
posts.tagline: A private habit tracker built for recovery, not streaks
posts.description: Most habit trackers make one missed day feel like failure. Habit Arc helps you build or reduce habits, recover at the next repetition, and keep your data on your phone. Free, offline, no account, no analytics.

posts.name: The FDE and AI Engineer Guide
posts.tagline: Turn real workflows into safe, measurable AI systems
posts.description: A practical open-source guide for FDEs, AI engineers, product teams, and operators building production AI systems. Start with real workflows and measurable value, choose the smallest sufficient mix of rules, ML, models, agents, and human review, then ship with secure tool contracts, evaluations, release gates, observability, and operating playbooks. Includes templates, blueprints, controls, and executable examples.

posts.name: opti-pipe
posts.tagline: Stop guessing Spark/dbt config values
posts.description: opti-pipe reads your Spark/dbt pipeline config alongside real run metrics and tells you what’s misconfigured — with the reasoning shown, not just a number to change. Rule-based and fully auditable, nothing auto-applies. dbt has a real integration (upload your own run_results.json); Spark runs on sample data for now.

posts.name: Dashboard Widgets Pack
posts.tagline: 50+ React dashboard widgets, ready to copy-paste
posts.description: A collection of 50+ ready-to-use React dashboard widgets built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Includes charts, cards, tables, and analytics components powered by Recharts and Framer Motion animations. Just copy, paste, and customize — no need to build UI components from scratch. Perfect for developers building admin panels, SaaS dashboards, or internal tools who want to save hours of design and development time.

posts.name: TeraAirlift
posts.tagline: Send massive files, with no size or bandwidth restrictions.
posts.description: TeraAirlift is a desktop file transfer platform built for teams moving massive files and datasets. Send, receive, track, and manage large transfers without the complexity of traditional cloud storage. Designed for video production, LiDAR, construction, VFX, 3D scanning, and other data-heavy workflows where tools like WeTransfer and Dropbox start to fall short.

posts.name: Mochi
posts.tagline: Your AI calorie tracking coach, in iMessage
posts.description: Most calorie trackers die the same way: you forget to open the app after a few days, and the streak breaks. Mochi fixes this by living in your most used app: iMessage. What Mochi does: • Text or photograph your food → get an instant macro breakdown (protein/carbs/fat) • Tracks water, weight, and daily calorie goals automatically • Sends proactive check-ins/texts • Streak tracking with shareable milestone cards • Full web dashboard with trend graphs for weight, calories, and streaks

posts.name: Pencilmind
posts.tagline: A local-first workspace for visual thinking and planning
posts.description: A next-generation visual thinking space for freehand drawing, professional diagrams, and rich notes.

posts.name: Carly by SlashExperts

posts.description: Carly is the AI agent at the core of SlashExperts, the Trust Layer for B2B Sales. She delivers the right customer proof — a case study, expert, or reference — to prospects at the exact moment they need confidence to move.

posts.name: Travel Risk Checker
posts.tagline: Your destination’s safety, weather, and routes in one place.
posts.description: WandeRisk is a free tool that helps travelers check current conditions before a trip. Search a destination to see a concise assessment based on recent safety events, official travel advice, weather, transport disruption and other factors that may affect your travel. Then make an informed decision.

posts.name: Snifter
posts.tagline: See every cocktail you can make with the bottles you own
posts.description: Add your bottles by describing them in plain words or snapping your shelf — parsed on-device. Snifter instantly shows every classic you can make right now, plus which single bottle unlocks the most new drinks — that hint is free, not paywalled. 78 classics with exact, bartender-accurate measures. Works offline; your bottles and logs stay on your device, with no account. One-time $4.99 unlocks the AI input and your drink log — no subscription, no ads.

posts.name: OraLoy
posts.tagline: Get The Exact AI output you desire on the first try!
posts.description: OraLoy is designed for anyone using AI models who wants to eliminate the frustration of prompt engineering. It rewrites your prompts on the fly, ensuring you get the exact output you need without multiple iterations. Say goodbye to trial and error and hello to efficiency.

posts.name: Sentiora
posts.tagline: The operational intelligence layer  for customer-facing AI.
posts.description: Monitor AI conversations, detect policy violations, investigate incidents, and give your team the operational insights needed to continuously improve your AI applications.

posts.name: Qalyze
posts.tagline: 200+ automated checks for your website in 60 seconds
posts.description: Qalyze runs 200+ automated tests on any website in 60 seconds. No signup, no waiting, nothing to install. It checks what Google PageSpeed doesn't: GDPR cookie compliance, legal notice requirements, security headers, AI/AEO visibility, mobile experience, and 9 more categories. Built specifically for the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland) and Hungary. Local law is built in, not bolted on.

posts.name: LinkMails
posts.tagline: AI-powered email outreach that gets replies
posts.description: Managing multilingual client emails shouldn't eat up hours of your day. Key capabilities: • Auto-sorts inquiries, orders, & complaints • Real-time translation (8+ languages) • Human-sounding, personalized draft replies with customer memory No templates or robotic copy—just AI handling the routine work so you only review what matters. We’d love your feedback!
